name: Storage Account
description: Azure storage account naming per CAF. The storage account name IS the public endpoint (e.g. stappprod001.blob.core.windows.net) and must be globally unique across all Azure tenants — uniqueness itself cannot be checked here. Lowercase letters and numbers only, no hyphens, maximum 24 characters.

fields.name: Workload
fields.tip: Use a short workload code such as app, vm, or your own — it concatenates directly into the endpoint hostname.
